items.title: Why Is Texas Instruments Stock Climbing Today?
items.summary: Shares of Texas Instruments (NASDAQ:TXN) rose 2. 7% in pre-market trading on Friday, supported by a recent analyst upgrade and improving sentiment across the semiconductor sector following several volatile trading sessions.

items.title: Analog Devices (ADI) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower After Mixed Analyst Target Revisions
items.summary: Analog Devices is back in focus after the Fair Value Estimate in one model was reduced from US$470.72 to US$441.34, a modest cut of around 6%. This move sits alongside recent research where some firms raised targets into the mid US$500s while others trimmed forecasts by US$50 to US$100. This reflects a split view on near term execution and spending. As you read on, you will see how these shifting targets feed into the broader analyst narrative and what to watch as the story evolves. items.title: Analog Devices Just Plunged After Earnings. Is Its Dividend Now a Bargain?
items.summary: Record revenue, a clear earnings beat, and still a 17% one-day wipeout. Analog Devices has raised its payout for 22 straight years, but one number in its outlook could decide whether that streak survives the AI boom.

items.title: Chip Stocks Just Pulled a Whipsaw Last Seen at the April 2025 Tariff Pause
items.summary: A CEO reinstatement sent chip stocks soaring one day and a fresh selloff erased most of it the next. Only two other sessions in three decades looked like this, and one involved a pandemic. What does the speed of the giveback reveal?

items.title: Analog Devices: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: The company is spending $1.6 billion to $1.9 billion on new capacity in fiscal 2027, a bet that will shape how much growth turns into shareholder cash.

items.title: ADI Q4 Earnings Call Points Capacity Push and Supply Bottlenecks
items.summary: ADI plans to more than double fiscal 2027 capital spending to ease supply bottlenecks as data center demand surges and growth extends beyond AI-focused markets.
